purpose: Record the relieved flow-meter cover's fit in the earlier receiver and the visible seating of its wings.
tried: The full-length flow-meter cover with +0.40 mm wing crests and 0.40 mm saddle relief, fitted over the meter in the earlier printed receiver.
derek: And even better, we now have the same fit on all of them. This fit is firm and holds well. But it is not perfect.
observed: Derek accepted the firm hold. The wings sat very slightly short of full seating. He could see this at the exposed cross section or by looking very closely.
receiver_scope: The bench receivers predate this cover shape. Which contact gives the firm hold, and whether it would persist with the wings fully seated, remain open.
